description: Traffic Volumes- City Centre Bridges Count Data 2007-2010 DCC is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Dublin City Council. Annual Traffic counts and turning data for all modes of transport at 26 locations in the city centre This dataset contains the results of the annual traffic counts conducted during the month of May each year, at twenty-six locations were selected along the Liffey Bridges between Heuston Station and the East Link Bridge and Parnell ... Coverage: Dublin City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Dublin City Council. Its tags are Transport and Infrastructure, traffic-counts, transportation-infrastructure. It offers 1 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
